edit_plan.hash_rule: json.dumps(plan, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')) -> bare sha256 hex

edit_plan_int_float_unicode.hash_rule: same as edit_plan; integer-versus-float wire representation is preserved, not normalized

build_plan.hash_rule: exclude planId; json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) -> 'sha256:' + hex

build_plan_unicode_null.hash_rule: same as build_plan; synthetic serialization case (Unicode partName, null source)
build_plan_unicode_null.validation: synthetic; hash computed by the original _plan_id

feature_plan.hash_rule: exclude planId; json.dumps(sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) defaults (', ', ': ', ensure_ascii=True) -> 'sha256:' + hex

feature_plan_unicode_null.hash_rule: same as feature_plan; synthetic serialization case
feature_plan_unicode_null.validation: synthetic; hash computed by the original inline rule
